governingStatute: Central Goods and Services Tax Rules, 2017
title: Information to be furnished prior to commencement of movement of goods and generation of E-Way Bill
plainTextSummary: Every registered person who causes movement of goods of consignment value exceeding ₹50,000 in relation to a supply, for reasons other than supply, or due to inward supply from an unregistered person, shall, before commencement of such movement, furnish information relating to the said goods electronically on the common portal in Part A of FORM GST EWB-01. Where the goods are transported by the registered person as consignor or recipient as consignee, whether in his own conveyance or a hired one, the registered person or transporter shall generate the e-way bill after furnishing information in Part B of FORM GST EWB-01. Under Rule 138(10) as amended by Notification No. 94/2020-Central Tax w.e.f. 01.01.2021, the validity of an e-way bill for other than Over Dimensional Cargo is 1 day for every 200 km or part thereof.

keyStatutoryThresholds.ewbValidityExtensionWindow: Within 8 hours prior to or after expiry of validity
keyStatutoryThresholds.ewbNumberFormat: 12-digit unique electronic identifier generated by EWB common portal
keyStatutoryThresholds.rule138EBlockingCondition: E-Way Bill generation blocked if GSTR-3B/GSTR-1 not filed for two consecutive tax periods

officialCitations.authority: Central Board of Indirect Taxes and Customs (CBIC)

requiredDocumentChecklist: Tax invoice, bill of supply, or delivery challan corresponding to goods movement
FORM GST EWB-01 Part A details (Supplier GSTIN, Recipient GSTIN, PIN codes, HSN code, value)
FORM GST EWB-01 Part B details (Vehicle number, Transporter ID, LR/RR/Airway bill number)
Verification that consignment value exceeds statutory threshold of ₹50,000
Calculated distance verification and expiration timestamp according to Rule 138(10)
